name: What is the difference between stock, semi-custom, and custom cabinets in terms of installation coordination?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between stock, semi-custom, and custom cabinets in terms of installation coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main difference for installation coordination lies in lead times, flexibility, and potential for on-site adjustments. Stock cabinets have the shortest lead times and are standard sizes, often requiring more fillers or adjustments during installation. Semi-custom cabinets offer more size and finish options with moderate lead times and less on-site modification. Custom cabinets provide complete design flexibility, but have the longest lead times due to bespoke manufacturing. Frasheski Construction considers these differences during project planning to manage timelines and ensure that all components arrive and fit as expected, especially with the unique dimensions often found in older homes across the East Bay area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stock cabinets have short lead times with more on-site adjustments, semi-custom offer more options with moderate lead times, and custom cabinets have long lead times with complete flexibility. Lead times and on-site adjustments vary significantly.
